title: Retro findings
description: Data for one interactive retro. scripts/retro.mjs render validates it and inlines it into assets/template.html.

intro.description: One or two plain sentences: which session, what it delivered, how many findings.

steering.description: Steering inputs from step 3, one per line. Shown folded on the Start view.

handoff.description: Shown once every finding is decided: what happens to approved findings.

findings.description: Render orders findings high, medium, low; within a severity it keeps this order, so list the costlier finding first.

id.description: Stable key, e.g. f1. Decisions are stored under it; never renumber.

title.description: Plain-language statement of what went wrong.

category.description: Retro category, e.g. Automated check, Steering source.

status.description: gap: nothing handles it; proposal: a fix is proposed; mostly: largely fixed already; covered: already fixed, shown for the record.

cost.description: What it cost the session, e.g. "20 min · 1 extra review round".

happened.description: What happened: what the session hit, with a real example and exact error text.

why.description: Why: the root cause, naming the owning source.

fix.description: Fix proposal: the change, in one or two sentences.

stage.description: Stage where it went wrong: exploration, planning, implementation or review.

rec.description: Your recommendation, starting with Approve, Later or Skip.

thread.description: Earlier rounds: each user note and your answer. Empty in round 1.

rev.description: Round number. Bump it when you answer a note.

outcome.description: What was done after the decision. Empty until something lands.

visuals.description: Optional show-me visual for each section, rendered right below that section's text. Use the smallest view that makes the point.

kind.description: diff: lines starting with +, - or a space; tree: a call, file or component tree; code: pseudocode or a snippet; log: exact error or command output.

caption.description: Optional one-line label, e.g. the file name.
